summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of offline-first PWA 'Bengkel & Toko Sparepart Motor'. All features tested and working correctly including dashboard, inventory management, item CRUD operations, scan with AI (OCR + visual matching), manual search, settings, backup/restore, and offline functionality. Service worker active with 7 model files cached. All UI in Bahasa Indonesia with proper Rp formatting.

Recent list shows empty state initially, populates after scans

Photo upload via gallery input works
Brand and motor chips selection works
Stock stepper and track-stock switch functional
Form validation for missing name/sell price
Save navigates to item detail page
Item detail displays all information correctly
Cost/profit/margin masking with eye toggle
Stock adjustment (+/-) updates correctly
